messages:
Lina (Support): heads-up — acme reported repeated FunctionCall failures in prod  us-east-1. Happens on generate requests that include `tool: translateText` (they say it used to work). stack shows 

acme-infra (Customer): hey, our users get 500s when we send function calls to the Translate tool. Example error: `ToolNotFoundError: no tool registered for name 'translateText'`

Lina (Support): thanks. Can you paste the raw request + headers? do you call via hosted API or dedicated? any recent SDK updates? :thinking_face:

acme-infra (Customer): using hosted API via our backend — single API key. No SDK updates from our side. Request body snippet: ```json
{
  "model": "gpt-infer-1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"translate this"}],
  "function_call": {"name": "translateText", "arguments": {"lang":"fr"}}
} 
```

Samir (Eng): pinging from eng — initial thought: registry name mismatch. We recently renamed `translate_text` -> `translateText` in the tool registry for consistency, but registry-sync job failed last night due to a transient 502 to model-indexer. If customer is hitting a node that still uses the old registry, they'd get ToolNotFound. Do we have registry-sync errors in logs? @deploy-bot can you dump registry sync job logs for last 12h?

deploy-bot: registry-sync job: attempt 2024-06-15T03:12:14Z -> FAILED status 502 from indexer-api. Retries disabled. Last successful sync: 2024-06-14T23:47:02Z.

Anya (Product): if that's the case, impact is broad: any function alias/rename can cause silent 500s for customers who cached function manifests. Need fast mitigation. Lina — can you ask acme if they can switch to `function_call: {"name": "translate_text"}` temporarily? Also check if they use a local cache of function registry.

acme-infra (Customer): we do cache the manifest for 10m. Changing the call is a big risk. can you rollback or patch upstream? Our SLAs are failing.

Samir (Eng): workaround we can push: gateway-side alias mapping that accepts both `translateText` and `translate_text`. I can craft a hotfix to add a small alias map in the request router. Minimal risk, no model changes. Will need edge deploy.

Lina (Support): sounds good. ETA? Customer requests a hotfix within 1h if possible.

Samir (Eng): I can push a canary in 15m. Steps: 1) add alias entry in /etc/func-aliases.json on gateway nodes: ```json
{
  "translateText": "translate_text",
  "Translate": "translate_text"
}
```
2) restart request-router service (systemd restart request-router) on canary nodes 3) monitor 5xx rate and error class `ToolNotFoundError`

Anya (Product): make sure to track which customers hit canary — we need to confirm fix for acme specifically. Also flag billing/incident for postmortem.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started by Samir at 2024-06-15T04:02:12Z on gateway-gw-04.

Samir (Eng): canary logs show `translateText` being mapped -> `translate_text` and routed to translate-worker pool. Error rate for acme requests dropped from 37% -> 2% on canary nodes. Rolling to remainder now.

Lina (Support): acme confirms things improved: acme-infra: "we're seeing success responses for the last 20 requests, thanks — please keep us posted." :raised_hands:

Samir (Eng): root cause summary: registry-sync failed during a transition where we updated canonical tool names (casing + snake_case->camelCase). Some gateway nodes refreshed registry earlier than others; nodes that didn't sync used old names so function calls with new names returned ToolNotFoundError. Also discovered SDK users that cache the function manifest can break on renames.

Anya (Product): actions: 
- short: hotfix alias mapping deployed and rolled out (Samir).
- medium: change release process to include backwards-compatible aliases automatically for 72h after any function rename.
- long: add versioned function IDs + deprecation window + automated registry-synced push to edge nodes.

Lina (Support): I've told acme: we deployed a fix and will add aliases + postmortem. asking them to avoid renaming calls for now. Planning a 1:1 postmortem with customer.

acme-infra (Customer): appreciate the quick response. any clue on how to avoid this on our side?

Samir (Eng): recommended: don't rely on local long-term caching of function manifests; refresh on error and optionally fallback to text-mode (no function calling) for critical flows. We'll add a `function_aliases` header customers can use temporarily with value `{"translateText":"translate_text"}` (will support soon).

Lina (Support): follow-ups: Samir to file PR for alias autopopulate, Anya to update release checklist, Lina to run customer postmortem. I'll mark this thread resolved once PR is merged and customer signs off.

Samir (Eng): PR opened: r/inference#842 add gateway alias layer and retry logic for registry-sync. includes tests for casing variants and schema validation.

Lina (Support): closing note — watch out for `schema_validation_failed` in logs as well; if the function signature changed during rename we could see `schema_validation_failed: missing required arg 'text'`. If that crops up we'll need stronger compatibility checks.

acme-infra (Customer): closing on our side too. thanks everyone :heart:
